items.title: We proudly present: Crystal 1.22
items.content:
We proudly present: Crystal 1.22Our newest and shiniest release 💎

It's also the biggest release since 1.0 with 251 changes in total.Some of the highlights:

- Performance improvements for DWARF loader- All targets support a native event loop

- Constants can have type declarations

- `Crystal::ALL_FLAGS` and `USER_FLAGS`

- Upgraded package dependencies, docker base images etc.

- Binaries for `aarch64-windows`
